title: console: a record-drawer level over a record page loses the child's own related tabs — the record route's object scope never loads the grandchild objects, and the registry joins only for ?recordId=
body:
Found while building a metadata app on the published packages (downstream card: steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#45, held `pm:blocked` on this one). Reproduced on `@objectstack/console` 18.3.0; the same code is on `main` at `64551047`. Sibling defect in the same drawer-stack family, separate seam: objectstack-ai/objectstack#33111 (header Edit opens the route object's form).

## Symptom

On a parent's **full page** (`/crm_cb_order/record/:id`), open a child (`crm_allocation_plan`) from the related list into a drawer level. The level shows only Overview / Activity and an overflow with the back-reference (`Sales Orders (0)`); the child's own related lists — `crm_allocation_line` and `crm_plan_expense`, both `masterDetail` to `crm_allocation_plan` — are missing, plain and maximized. The child's full page shows them, and so does the **list drawer** host (`/crm_cb_order?recordId=…`), from the same metadata (control legs). No page is authored for either object, so this is not a layout difference — the same synthesized page sees a smaller objects list.

## Producer (main)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:2342-2343` — a level derives its tabs as `deriveRelatedLists(objectDef, objects, …)`, where `objects` is the host route's `allObjects`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts:568` — a record route without a declared page scopes to the app package plus `readObjectsReferencing(route.objectName)`: the objects pointing at the **route's** object only, so the child is loaded but its own children are not.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:545` — `drawerReadsRegistry = !!objectScope && searchParamsHasRecordDrawer(location.search)`: the whole registry is joined only when `?recordId=` is in the URL (lines 553-555). `RecordPageDrawerHost` levels live in component state, not the URL (`views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` header lines 23-27, host at ~854), so the record-page drawer never triggers the join.

Observed reads on the parent full page: `object?package=…` (the app package's objects) plus `sys_*` by name, no whole-registry `meta/object` read; on the list drawer host, adding `?recordId=` triggers the `meta/object` read and the tabs appear.

## Repro (18.3.0)

1. `/crm_cb_order/record/PARENT` → related tab "Allocation Plans" → open a plan into the drawer → tabs: Overview / Activity, overflow `Sales Orders (0)`; maximize: identical.
2. Control A: `/crm_allocation_plan/record/PLAN` → Overview / Activity / Allocation Lines (2).
3. Control B: `/crm_cb_order` → open the order (list drawer, `?recordId=`) → plan level → Overview / Activity / Allocation Lines (3), overflow Plan Expenses (0), Sales Orders (0).

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

Make a drawer level's object scope follow the level's own object: either `RecordPageDrawerHost` levels trigger the same registry join `?recordId=` does, or opening a level reads `readObjectsReferencing(level.objectName)` into the scope the level derives its related lists from.

Dedupe words: record route object scope related lists drawer · deriveRelatedLists drawer missing grandchild · RecordPageDrawerHost registry.
